column2: All sorts of worlds are starting to join together like a patchwork... Whatever is about to happen...?
Great King-sama, he's a new member of the Yokai Patrol! {p} beat the yokai Beehive Nyudo!
Hmm! I shall create a subspace in Kyoto! First I'll send you there, then move Hell Villa after you! But before that, Enma, take this with you.
With this tool, my boy, you can summon your friends from Hell Villa in an instant, or send them back there. So long as you remain in the human world, it should work anywhere.
Whoa, that's one handy gadget! Thanks, Great King Enma-sama! All riiight! Oni hunting in Kyoto!
Thank you, Great King-sama!
Go, to Kyoto!
Then Akira-kun's world and...
The world of Ryu Takuma and the Abashiri Family...
Akira, so this is the {p} you told me about...
This is Ryo Asuka. My best friend.
Nice to meet you, Ryo-kun.
Yeah...
Let's get down to business!
So you're {p}! I've heard about you. I'm Seiji Hayami, newspaper reporter!
Nice to meet you, Seiji-san.
Yeah, likewise!
Let's get down to business!
Where are we?
Gotta be near the Dark Temple.
How can you tell?
'Cause my yokai antennae are going crazy. Hell Villa should be close by. Let's get ready and head for the Dark Temple.
The oni come...\n\nSoon to awaken, little by little, little by little... drawing near to me...
Hey, what the heck is this!? There's people collapsed all over the place!?
Did the oni do this?
Friends of Jiro Shutendo!
You will not reach the Dark Temple! Behold the power of the Kibutsu Clan!
What're these guys going on about? Whatever, let's just take 'em out!
Who's there!?
Whoa! This guy's got horns! Aha, so you're the oni!
Hold on, Enma-kun. Something's off about him...
Are you the Kibutsu Clan, you wretches!?
Kibutsu Clan? Could you be... Jiro Shutendo-kun?
How do you know my name?
Actually, some guys called the Kibutsu Clan attacked us just now.
You fought the Kibutsu Clan and came out fine? You're strong.
You bet we are!
My friends were all strong fighters too. But the Kibutsu Clan took them down...
That's awful...
What are you doing here...?
A girl named Miyuki Shiratori-san was kidnapped by the Kibutsu Clan. We came to rescue Miyuki-san.
This Miyuki-san... is she your girlfriend...?
Huh? N-no... well... um...
All right, got it! If that's how it is, we'll help you out! Right, {p}?
Hold on! Who exactly are you...!?
Actually...
...That's a strange story.\n\nBut still, I can't drag you into this.
Why not!?
The Kibutsu Clan is after me.
Then all the more reason!\n\nCharging in alone where the dirty Kibutsu Clan is lying in wait is dangerous!
It's because it's dangerous that I don't want you involved!
I want to go back to my own world!\n\nI need clues to get there!
Doji, I believe these people can be trusted.
Whoaaa!
I am no oni from the Hell World. I am Goki, born in the Kigoku World to protect Jiro Shutendo.
The Kigoku World? Just like Great King Enma said, there really are tons of other worlds in other dimensions...
Doji, let us go with them.
But I can't let anyone else be sacrificed...
It is precisely so no one else is sacrificed, Doji.
Besides, don't go deciding we're gonna be the ones sacrificed!
...All right. Let's go together!
If the enemy's launching an all-out attack, it'll be here.
Those fang-shaped rocks are perfect for hiding behind, too.
Are they lying in wait for us...?
It seems slaying the Shutendoji falls to us. It makes my birth worthwhile...! I give thanks... O Jarai-sama...!
Where is Miyuki-san!?
If you would save the girl, defeat the Somashu led by I, Jawanbo!
.........Jawanbo!
...That Jawanbo seemed like he was human...?
Ain't he way too strong to be human?
Those Kibutsu Clan guys are descendants of oni. They're trying to protect the world of the oni, the Kigoku World.
So why are the Kibutsu Clan after you, Jiro-kun?

Because it is said that the Shutendoji will destroy the Kigoku World. The Kigoku World is a realm of oni that came into being out of nowhere. As did I, and as did Doji...! One day, without warning, Doji "came into being" in a corner of the Kigoku World as a baby!
In the Kigoku World, where oni devour each other, a baby is little more than prey... And I knew it by instinct! That I existed to protect this baby!
Were you really born at that moment? Didn't you have a past before the Kigoku World?
I do not know. I want to know what I am myself! But all I know now\n\nis that I exist to protect the Shutendoji! That is why I fight at Doji's side!
Let us go... Doji...
The Kigoku World, a world that came into being out of nowhere...\n\nJust how many worlds are out there...?
Hey, {p}! What're you doing? Let's go!
Oh! Coming!
I've been waiting for you, Shutendoji!
Kitani!?
Who's that guy?
The man who infiltrated Doji's school to spy on him. And he is the very one who kidnapped Miyuki-san!!
Where is Miyuki-san!?
Do you think I ate her alive? She's right here!
Heeelp!
Miyuki-san!
Shutendoji!\n\nYou'd like to save Miyuki, but that's an impossible dream! You are all fated to die by my hand! Come forth, Madoki!!
Whoa, amaaazing!!
A real oni!
Ohh! Senki!?\n\nIt is said two oni guard the Shutendoji in the Kigoku World... The names of those two... Goki and Senki!
Exactly!\n\nAs long as we live, not a finger shall touch the Shutendoji!
Hey, this is getting super intense!?
Y-yeah...!
Goki! Senki! Let's go! We beat Kitani and save Miyuki-san!
Yes, Doji!!
All right! Let's go too, Enma-kun!
